King is suffering from cramps, so Hope collects King's Player-of-the-Match award on

Hope, WI captain: There was no hurry. They all bowled well, I can't single out too many, 
and I was happy with the execution. Nice to see Hodge play in West Indies colours now 
and hopefully we can continue. I don't think there were devils in the surface but credit 
needs to be given to the bowlers. King is an exceptional player and someone who I 
thought would've scored a lot more runs early in his career. But happy for him. He saw 
the opportunity to take the game forward and happy to see him get his first hundred 
today. 
Waseem, UAE captain: He [Paul] bowled well. Ali played well, but we were short by 50-

positives from this match and hopefully do well in other matches.
